coords: SVG convention: x = screen right, y = -Z (down); ground at y = 0, top of the robot at y = -446.2
raster: 6 px/mm crack-traced, Douglas-Peucker 0.15 mm; fill-rule evenodd

front.camera: camera on +X looking at the front; screen right = +Y (robot's left)
front.rotate: pitch joints are not planar in this view: use it static, or for explode (translate by explode Y, -Z)

side.camera: camera on -Y (the robot's right side); screen right = +X (forward)
side.rotate: a pitch angle a (deg, biped.json sign) is SVG transform="rotate(a px py)" about the pivot (px, py); nest the transforms down the chain (hip -> knee -> ankle)
